content_zh:
青云大陆，秦国，武安城。
热闹的大街之上，一名少年在侍女的搀扶下缓步朝苏府所在的方向走去。
少年身着白衣，身材匀称，挺鼻薄唇，腰间的玉佩在阳光的照耀下熠熠生辉。
可奇怪的是，他的双眼却是被一条缠绕的黑布所覆盖。
阳光下，少年的笑容显得格外灿烂。
少年名叫叶无尘，乃是武安城叶家少主。
叶无尘微微侧头，笑着朝身旁的侍女开口道：
“小月，我们走快点，清雪她昨晚觉醒了六品武魂，如今可是我们武安城的天才，我这个名义上的未婚夫若是不去祝贺一下可就说不过去了。”
小月全名叶夕月，乃是跟随叶无尘多年的侍女。
“要说天才，明明少爷你才是真正的天才好吧，十二岁便破开九脉，觉醒八品武魂，整个秦国哪还找的出能够比肩少爷的天才，只可惜...”
叶夕月不再多言，但她的心情却低落了下来。
想当初，叶无尘十二岁便破开了全部九条经脉，觉醒八品武魂，其天赋震惊了整个秦国。
正当所有人都认为叶无尘将以绝世之姿横扫秦国所有年轻一辈的时候，变故却出现了。
不知为何，叶无尘觉醒的武魂莫名消失，九脉不显，修为尽废。
甚至就连身体都出现了问题，沦为了一个双目失明的瞎子。
昔日的少年天骄，如今却成了一个衣食住行都要人照顾的废物瞎子。
何其可笑，何其...可悲。
然而，少年似乎早已释怀，他开玩笑似的朝身旁的侍女开口说道：
“过去的都过去了，现在的我还不是一个需要我家小月照顾的废人吗？到时候若是连小月都不要我了，那我才是真的惨咯。”
四年来形影不离的照顾，叶无尘跟叶夕月之间的关系早已不是什么主仆。

对叶无尘来说，叶夕月更像是亲人一般的存在。
“少爷，你又乱说话了。”
叶夕月羞红着脸回应道。
两人交谈之间，很快便来到了苏府门口。
苏家原本只是武安城的一个小世家，可自从与叶家联姻之后，在叶家各方面的帮助之下，其势力便开始迅速扩张。
再加上如今苏家大小姐苏清雪觉醒了六品武魂。
想必不久之后，苏家便能一跃成为武安城内最顶级的世家之一。
苏府之外，叶无尘在叶夕月的搀扶下朝府内走去。
可就在这时，守在苏府大门前的两名护卫却挡在了叶无尘身前。
叶无尘身旁，叶夕月看到这一幕脸色瞬间就变得难看了起来，开口朝二人呵斥道：
“徐虎，张炎，你们这是什么意思，连你们苏家的姑爷都敢拦，是不想活了吗？”
以往叶无尘来苏府做客的时候，这两名护卫就时常在背地里嘲讽叶无尘。
没想到这次竟更加大胆，直接将叶无尘拦在府门之外。
听到叶夕月此言，其中一名护卫嗤笑着开口说道：
“姑爷？一个废物瞎子也妄想当我苏家的姑爷？”
“小月，掌嘴。”
叶无尘冷声命令道。
对于这些护卫背地里嘲讽自己的话语，他向来都是一笑置之。
但这并不代表着叶无尘好欺负，他只不过懒得去追究罢了。
可如今，这些护卫的做法，已然越界了。
content_en:
Qingyun Continent, Qin State, Wu'an City.
On the busy street, a young man walked slowly towards the direction of Su Mansion with the support of a maid.
The young man was dressed in white, with a well-proportioned figure, a straight nose and thin lips, and the jade pendant around his waist shone in the sunlight.
But strangely, his eyes were covered by a twisted black cloth.
Under the sun, the boy's smile looked particularly bright.
The young man's name is Ye Wuchen, and he is the young master of the Ye family in Wu'an City.
Ye Wuchen tilted his head slightly, smiled and said to the maid beside him:
"Xiaoyue, let's go faster. Qingxue awakened the sixth-grade martial arts spirit last night and is now a genius in our Wu'an City. It would be unreasonable for my nominal fiancé not to congratulate her."
Xiaoyue's full name is Ye Xiyue, and she is the maid who has followed Ye Wuchen for many years.
"When it comes to genius, Master, you are obviously the real genius. You broke through the Nine Meridians and awakened the eighth-grade martial spirit at the age of twelve. There is no genius in the entire Qin Kingdom who can match the Master. It's a pity..."
Ye Xiyue said no more, but her mood dropped.
Back then, when Ye Wuchen was twelve years old, he opened all nine meridians and awakened the eighth-level martial spirit. His talent shocked the entire Qin Kingdom.
Just when everyone thought that Ye Wuchen would sweep all the younger generations of the Qin Kingdom with his peerless appearance, something unexpected happened.
For some unknown reason, Ye Wuchen's awakened martial spirit disappeared inexplicably, his nine veins disappeared, and his cultivation was completely ruined.
He even had physical problems and became a blind man.
The talented young man in the past has now become a useless blind man who needs people to take care of him for food, clothing, housing and transportation.
How ridiculous, how...pathetic.
However, the young man seemed to have already let go. He jokingly said to the maid beside him:
"The past has passed. Am I not a useless person who needs my Xiaoyue to take care of me now? If Xiaoyue doesn't want me anymore, then I will be really miserable."
After four years of inseparable care, the relationship between Ye Wuchen and Ye Xiyue was no longer that of master and servant.
To Ye Wuchen, Ye Xiyue was more like a relative.
"Master, you are talking nonsense again."
Ye Xiyue responded with a blushing face.
While the two were talking, they soon arrived at the door of Su Mansion.
The Su family was originally just a small aristocratic family in Wu'an City, but since its marriage to the Ye family, its power has begun to expand rapidly with the help of the Ye family in all aspects.
In addition, the eldest daughter of the Su family, Su Qingxue, has awakened a sixth-level martial spirit.
Presumably soon, the Su family will become one of the top families in Wu'an City.
Outside the Su Mansion, Ye Wuchen walked towards the mansion with Ye Xiyue's support.
But at this moment, the two guards guarding the gate of Su Mansion stood in front of Ye Wuchen.
Beside Ye Wuchen, Ye Xiyue's face instantly turned ugly when she saw this scene, and she yelled at the two of them:
"Xu Hu, Zhang Yan, what do you mean? Even your uncle from the Su family dares to stop you. Do you not want to live?"
In the past, when Ye Wuchen came to Su Mansion as a guest, these two guards would often mock Ye Wuchen behind his back.
Unexpectedly, he would be bolder this time and block Ye Wuchen directly from the door of the house.
Hearing Ye Xiyue's words, one of the guards sneered and said:
"Uncle? A useless blind man also wants to be the uncle of my Su family?"
"Xiaoyue, Zhang Zui."
Ye Wuchen ordered coldly.
He always laughed at the words of these guards who mocked him behind his back.
But this does not mean that Ye Wuchen is easy to bully, he is just too lazy to pursue it.
But now, what these guards are doing has crossed the line.
